title: YvO_2026: skeletal muscle proteome response to resistance training in younger and older adults
description:
Analysis code for a study of the vastus lateralis proteome in younger and older adults before and after resistance training. Thirty-two participants gave a biopsy before and after training, 64 samples in all, quantified by DIA mass spectrometry. Two outlier samples, Y_S05_Pre and Y_S07_Post, are removed, leaving 2,106 proteins across 62 samples. limma tests four contrasts: aging, training in younger adults, training in older adults, and the age by training interaction.

The code runs from the raw intensity workbook to every figure and supplementary table of the revised manuscript. Each figure panel has its own script. setup.R installs the package versions in renv.lock, and run_all.R runs the pipeline in about 22 minutes.

The vendored GSimp source in 02_imputation/a_script/benchmark/methods/gsimp_source/ is GPL-3; everything else is MIT.
